description: This file 'connect.c' contains implementation of network connection functions for Git, including protocol support, URL parsing, socket connections, SSH handling, and remote reference fetching.

methods.name: int check_ref(const char * name,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Checks if a given ref name matches specified flags such as branches, tags, or normal refs.

methods.name: int check_ref_type(const struct ref * ref,int flags)
methods.description: Checks if a ref object matches given type flags.

methods.name: NORETURN void die_initial_contact(int unexpected)
methods.description: Handles unexpected hang-up issues during initial contact in network protocol.

methods.name: int server_supports_v2(const char * c)
methods.description: Determines if the server supports a specific capability string prefixed capability.

methods.name: void ensure_server_supports_v2(const char * c)
methods.description: Verifies server supports a specified capability, otherwise terminates the process.

methods.name: int server_feature_v2(const char * c,const char ** v)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific feature's value from server capabilities if supported.

methods.name: int server_supports_feature(const char * c,const char * feature,int die_on_error)
methods.description: Checks if server supports a specific feature, optionally dies if not.

methods.name: void process_capabilities_v2(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads server capabilities lines into server_capabilities_v2 vector.

methods.name: enum:protocol_version discover_version(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Identifies protocol version supported by server during handshake.

methods.name: void parse_one_symref_info(struct string_list * symref,const char * val,int len)
methods.description: Parses a ref symbolic ref info line.

methods.name: void annotate_refs_with_symref_info(struct ref * ref)
methods.description: Associates symbolic ref info with reference objects.

methods.name: void process_capabilities(struct packet_reader * reader,size_t * linelen)
methods.description: Processes server response line with server capabilities and object format.

methods.name: int process_dummy_ref(const struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Checks if a line contains a dummy ref representing capabilities.

methods.name: void check_no_capabilities(const char * line,size_t len)
methods.description: Warns if capabilities lines are improperly placed after initial response.

methods.name: int process_ref(const struct packet_reader * reader,size_t len,struct ref *** list,unsigned int flags,struct oid_array * extra_have)
methods.description: Processes a ref line, adding to reference list if valid.

methods.name: int process_shallow(const struct packet_reader * reader,size_t len,struct oid_array * shallow_points)
methods.description: Processes a shallow-sha line for shallow repository support.

methods.name: struct:ref ** get_remote_heads(struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref ** list,unsigned int flags,struct oid_array * extra_have,struct oid_array * shallow_points)
methods.description: Reads all remote refs from the server and populates reference list.

methods.name: int process_ref_v2(struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref *** list,const char ** unborn_head_target)
methods.description: Parses a line of v2 style ref info, updating ref list and unborn head info.

methods.name: void check_stateless_delimiter(int stateless_rpc,struct packet_reader * reader,const char * error)
methods.description: Verifies if the protocol delimiter packet is as expected.

methods.name: void send_capabilities(int fd_out,struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Sends capabilities information to server.

methods.name: int get_remote_bundle_uri(int fd_out,struct packet_reader * reader,struct bundle_list * bundles,int stateless_rpc)
methods.description: Requests a remote bundle URI from server for optimized transfer.

methods.name: struct:ref ** get_remote_refs(int fd_out,struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref ** list,int for_push,struct transport_ls_refs_options * transport_options,const struct string_list * server_options,int stateless_rpc)
methods.description: Fetches remote references with capabilities and options.

methods.name: const char * parse_feature_value(const char * feature_list,const char * feature,size_t * lenp,size_t * offset)
methods.description: Parses a specific feature value from a feature list string.

methods.name: int server_supports_hash(const char * desired,int * feature_supported)
methods.description: Checks if server supports specific object hash formats.

methods.name: int parse_feature_request(const char * feature_list,const char * feature)
methods.description: Checks if a feature is requested in feature list.

methods.name: const char * next_server_feature_value(const char * feature,size_t * len,size_t * offset)
methods.description: Retrieves next server feature value string for a given feature.

methods.name: const char * server_feature_value(const char * feature,size_t * len)
methods.description: Gets current server feature value string for a feature.

methods.name: int server_supports(const char * feature)
methods.description: Checks if server supports a feature by querying feature list.

methods.name: int url_is_local_not_ssh(const char * url)
methods.description: Determines if a URL is local filesystem path and not SSH.

methods.name: const char * prot_name(enum protocol protocol)
methods.description: Returns the string name of protocol type.

methods.name: enum:protocol get_protocol(const char * name)
methods.description: Returns protocol enum from string name.

methods.name: char * host_end(char ** hoststart,int removebrackets)
methods.description: Finds endpoint of hostname part, handling brackets for IPv6.

methods.name: void get_host_and_port(char ** host,const char ** port)
methods.description: Extracts host and port from a URL component.

methods.name: void enable_keepalive(int sockfd)
methods.description: Enables TCP keepalive on socket.

methods.name: int git_tcp_connect_sock(char * host,int flags)
methods.description: Connects socket using IPv4 or IPv6, involving hostname resolution.

methods.name: enum:protocol parse_connect_url(const char * url_orig,char ** ret_host,char ** ret_path)
methods.description: Parses a connection URL into protocol, host, and path components.

methods.name: const char * get_ssh_command(void)
methods.description: Gets SSH command from environment or config.

methods.name: void override_ssh_variant(enum ssh_variant * ssh_variant)
methods.description: Overrides SSH variant based on environment or config.

methods.name: enum:ssh_variant determine_ssh_variant(const char * ssh_command,int is_cmdline)
methods.description: Detects SSH variant type based on command used.

methods.name: struct:child_process * git_connect_git(int fd[2],char * hostandport,const char * path,const char * prog,enum protocol_version version,int flags)
methods.description: Establishes Git native protocol connection, handles headers.

methods.name: void push_ssh_options(struct strvec * args,struct strvec * env,enum ssh_variant variant,const char * port,enum protocol_version version,int flags)
methods.description: Configures SSH options for invocation.

methods.name: void fill_ssh_args(struct child_process * conn,const char * ssh_host,const char * port,enum protocol_version version,int flags)
methods.description: Prepares args for SSH invocation, considering environment and variant.

methods.name: struct:child_process * git_connect(int fd[2],const char * url,const char * name,const char * prog,int flags)
methods.description: Main function to establish connection to remote, handling protocols (git, SSH, file).

methods.name: int finish_connect(struct child_process * conn)
methods.description: Ends a connection, cleans up resources.
